title: Signature · AI-shell (stream + side panel + capability cards)
description: Hub-page signature AI section. Three stacked layers: eyebrow + H2 + 2 leads on top; a 2-column 'AI shell' (terminal-style activity stream on the left + media placeholder side-panel on the right) in the middle; 3 capability cards (A.NN numbered) at the bottom. Light theme. This is the platform's biggest visual differentiator on the hub landing.

params.default: AI-Native
AI-Native Operational Automation

ServiceWand is designed as an AI-native operational platform, not a traditional field service tool with AI added as an afterthought. AI is most useful when it has access to structured operational data.
ServiceWand supports AI-assisted workflows, operational automation, intelligent routing support, and workflow intelligence — built around real operational data, not surface-level chat.
Operational AI · sample activity

All actions stay reviewable. Nothing leaves the platform until your team confirms.

One operational model. Every domain feeds it.

AI workflow screenshot / assistant panel
A.
Draft & Reviewable
AI proposes; humans approve. Every action lands in a draft surface — dispatch, billing, customer comms — until a team member confirms.
Operational Data, Not Chat
AI reads jobs, routes, customers, assets, and billing as one model. Patterns surface across domains, not inside a single chat window.
Audit Trail by Default
Every AI decision is logged with the trigger, the data it saw, and what your team did with it. Compliance, training, and trust come from the same record.

notes: Composite of 3 sub-patterns: ai-stream (terminal log), ai-side-panel (media placeholder + tagged feeds), ai-caps (numbered capability cards). They could be split into 3 lab-ui blocks but ship together because all 3 are designed for one section and never used independently in the kit.
Accent uses the normalized secondary CTA contract: --cta-secondary-fill for mono labels and --cta-accent for tints, marks, and subtle panel glow.

The side-panel visual is a neutral striped media placeholder, not an orbit illustration. Replace [data-ai-media-slot] with a product screenshot or assistant panel image when real assets are available.
At ≤980 px the shell collapses to a single column (stream on top, side-panel below). At ≤640 px the stream rows collapse from 3-col into stacked time/kind/content.
